gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-m-plus-2: Chunky pixels, loud and playful. Pixelify Sans carries that swagger up top, and M PLUS 2 follows with a gaping, friendly c that makes the pair feel approachable.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-m-plus-code-lati: M PLUS Code Latin bends its letters like neon tubing, each c opening wide as a pitcher's mouth, under Pixelify Sans. Text reads smooth and clean.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-m-plus-rounded-1: Expressive is the first word Pixelify Sans earns, with every diagonal as stout as its uprights. M PLUS Rounded 1c is happiest in quiet running text, its terminals stopping short of curling back.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-mandali: Mandali sits quietly below Pixelify Sans, friendly and clean. Over a long stretch, the generous entry into each e's eye keeps lines easy on the eye, a gentle foil to the rod-like, single-weight pixel heading.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-manjari: Manjari settles under the heading with curves that end in wide, unclosed terminals, approachable and professional. And Pixelify Sans, bold and expressive, gives that plain sans something loud to lean against.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-meera-inimai: Pixelify Sans shouts in blocky, expressive pixels. Meera Inimai does the opposite job, with open-ended curves and a blueprint-lettering feel of constant line that lets the text breathe.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-metrophobic: Modern and clean, this pair splits the work sharply. Pixelify Sans is best at bold, pixel-stamped display lines, while Metrophobic, a plain sans, sends a smooth, unobstructed path around each bend.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-mina: Blocky, bold and unmistakably digital. Pixelify Sans does the shouting with its pixel-cut c, and Mina answers with stitched-outline plainness and generously unclosed small curves.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-moderustic: Moderustic reads modern, its broad-nib curves left pleasantly unfinished. Under Pixelify Sans, whose strokes are like cut ribbon of constant width, that plain sans adds a looser, contemporary counterpoint to the pixel heading.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-molengo: Pixel-sharp and brash, built from one pen line. Molengo's wide gaps keep a plain sans crisp and neutral, so extended reading stays easy beneath the heading's bold, expressive character.
